flag.instructions_to_ai: Contains text aimed at an AI. It was ignored — check the details against the original yourself.
flag.payment_details: Asks for a payment or gives new payment details — a common fraud pattern. Confirm with the sender using contact details you already have.
flag.inconsistency: Something doesn't add up, such as a weekday that doesn't match the date.
flag.hidden_text: Contained invisible characters, which can hide instructions; they were removed before analysis.
flag.other: Something here looks off — take a closer look.

today.welcomeBody: Create a project, save your go-to replies, or upload an offer and let us sort out the details.
today.nextActionsEmpty: Nothing due soon. New to-dos will show up here.

finance.revenueEmpty: No payments received yet. The chart updates as you record them.
finance.metricNetNote: Received minus paid — not accounting profit
finance.footnote: Received and paid filter by settled date; outstanding and to-pay by recorded date. You set the tax rate per entry; withholding, exchange differences, and tax-filing adjustments aren't included. TWD only for now.
finance.voidHelp: Void an entry made by mistake or duplicated: it drops out of every total but stays here and can be restored. Past months don't need voiding — use the date filter.

insights.contractNote: From all live signed projects, not the date range above. A contract amount isn't income received.
insights.unknownQuotes: {count, plural, one {# more signed project has} other {# more signed projects have}} no quote yet and {count, plural, one {isn't} other {aren't}} in the total.
insights.cashTitle: Cash in and out, last six months
insights.agingNote: From the due dates of all outstanding, non-voided income; entries without a due date are listed on their own.

projects.empty: No matching projects. Add your first one or adjust the filters.

phaseCaption.negotiation: Offers, quotes, and getting to a signature. Replies to messages stay in the inbox.
phaseCaption.execution: Signed work: track deliverables, schedule, and payment milestones.
phaseCaption.settlement: After delivery: invoicing, balances, and closed projects.
phaseCaption.ended: Declined or cancelled projects, kept for reference.

stageNote.offer: Just received — confirm the type of work and the basics.
stageNote.negotiating: Replying and settling terms; no execution to-dos yet.
stageNote.signed: Signed — schedule deliverables, travel, and payment milestones.
stageNote.in_progress: Underway — deliverables, travel, and payment milestones are on the to-do list.
stageNote.collecting_payment: Delivered — track invoices, the balance, and costs.
stageNote.closed: Delivery and payments reconciled; the project is done.
stageNote.cancelled: The project was cancelled. Handle any remaining payments on their own.

projects.notSignedNote: Still in negotiation. Once it's signed (stage 已簽約 / Signed or later), you can add linked to-dos, events, and payments.

workflow.toConfirm: What to confirm for this project
workflow.draftForProject: Draft a reply for this project

warn.noItems: No calendar items or deliverable to-dos yet
warn.openTodos: {count, plural, one {# to-do still open} other {# to-dos still open}}
warn.overbilled: Billed {amount} more than quoted — check for duplicates or an outdated quote
warn.shortfall: Received {amount} less than billed (withholding or fees? please check)
warn.unpaidCosts: {count, plural, one {# cost not paid yet} other {# costs not paid yet}}

workflow.allClear: Recorded to-dos and payments reconcile; still confirm deliverables and contract obligations yourself.
workflow.stageNote: You decide the stage — changing it doesn't record payments or complete to-dos.
workflow.planIntro: Creates two outstanding payments from this project's tax-inclusive quote. This doesn't mean anything has been paid.
workflow.planInvalid: Check the quote and percentage — both parts must be greater than zero.
workflow.planNote: The balance absorbs rounding. For three or more installments or uneven amounts, add linked payment requests one by one.
workflow.planNeedsSigned: Set up the deposit and balance once the project is signed.
workflow.planNeedsQuote: Set the quote first, then split it into deposit and balance.

inbox.title: Offers to review
inbox.intro: Paste an offer and the system pulls out the key facts and suggests a type; nothing becomes a project until you confirm. Screenshot upload and the Gmail add-on are on the way.
inbox.emptyBody: Use “Paste an offer” to bring in your first one.
inbox.pick: Pick a message to see it.
inbox.pastePlaceholder: Paste a LINE, Instagram, or email conversation here…
inbox.pasteHint: It's only read and summarized as a suggestion — nothing is replied to or created on its own.
inbox.duplicate: You've brought this in before — here it is.
inbox.pendingBody: The AI is reading this message; the result appears here on its own. The local model takes about half a minute.
inbox.aiNote: An AI suggestion and may be wrong — check before filing. Confidence {confidence}% · {model}
inbox.foreignCurrency: Fee stated as {amount} — only TWD is supported for now, so the quote is left blank.
inbox.uploadDrop: Drop screenshots, photos, or PDFs here, or
inbox.uploadHint: Upload all the screenshots of one conversation together, in order (oldest first). Up to {files} files, {megabytes} MB in total.
inbox.uploadTotal: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · {megabytes} MB
inbox.uploadUnsupported: Only screenshots, photos (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC), and PDFs can be sent in; other files were left out.
inbox.uploadFailed: An upload didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.

failure.busy: The AI service is busy right now. Try “Analyze again” in a minute.
failure.rate_limited: The AI service's usage limit was reached. Try again later.
failure.recitation: The AI service wouldn't process this — it looks like published text, such as lyrics or an article.
failure.blocked: The AI service's safety filters blocked this content.
failure.too_long: This is too long for the AI to read in one go. Send fewer files or pages.
failure.unreachable: Couldn't reach the AI service. Check the connection or settings and try again.
failure.invalid_output: The AI's answer wasn't usable. Try “Analyze again”.
failure.not_configured: The AI service isn't set up on this server.
failure.unsupported_file: The current AI model can't read this kind of file.
failure.unexpected: Something unexpected went wrong. Try “Analyze again”.
failure.replay_missing: No recorded answer for this message, and this environment only replays recordings (AI_REPLAY=only).
failure.usage_limit: Today's AI analyses for this account are used up. Try “Analyze again” once it resets (within 24 hours).

inbox.transcriptWithheld: The AI service wouldn't write out this file's text (it looks like published material), so there's no transcript.
inbox.notWork: This doesn't look like a work message. If you don't need it, dismiss it.
inbox.dataNotice: What you send is analyzed by {service}. This setup uses its free tier: under its terms, content may be kept, used to improve its services, and read by reviewers. Avoid including passwords, verification codes, ID numbers, or bank account numbers.
inbox.usageExhausted: Today's {limit} AI analyses are used up. New messages are saved and can be analyzed once it resets.

calendarFeed.title: Calendar subscription
calendarFeed.intro: Add this private link to Google or Apple Calendar and confirmed events show up automatically — no calendar account connection needed. Calendar apps refresh on their own schedule (Google can take several hours).
calendarFeed.copyNowDetail: For security it's shown only once; if you lose it, reset the link.
calendarFeed.localHint: This is a local development address (http), which webcal can't open. In Apple Calendar choose File → New Calendar Subscription and paste the link above.
calendarFeed.googleHint: Google Calendar: on desktop, click + next to “Other calendars”, choose “From URL”, and paste the link. Anyone with the link can see your schedule, so don't share it publicly.
calendarFeed.resetNote: Resetting stops the old link immediately.

editor.paymentHelp: One entry is one complete payment. Split staged payments into deposit and balance; keep it “Outstanding” until the money arrives. Received and paid totals use the settled date. If less arrives than billed (withholding tax, the NHI supplementary premium), enter the amount received — the gap is shown separately.
editor.templateHelp: You can use {placeholders}. Missing values are marked to confirm. A past reply can't be applied directly — before saving it as a template, remove the old project's names, fees, and dates.
editor.notWired: This kind of record isn't connected to the database yet — saving is in development.
editor.languageHelp: The language this reply is written in — placeholders and quotes fill in that language.
editor.quoteHelp: Leave the amount blank if the fee isn't decided yet; 0 means unpaid.
editor.signedOnly: Only signed projects are listed. Linking is optional.
editor.travelHelp: Times are local, in each place's own time zone (e.g. Asia/Taipei, Asia/Tokyo). Not connected to live flight, rail, or hotel booking data.
editor.contactUnlinked: Not linked to a contact — saved on this project only
editor.contactHint: Search your partners by name or company, or type a new name

drafts.pastReplyRefused: A past reply is for reference only and can't be applied directly. Save it as a template first, replacing the old project's names, fees, and dates with placeholders.
drafts.libraryHelp: Each project type keeps its own. Reply templates fill in the current project's details; past replies are for reference — remove the old project's details before saving one as a template.

errors.invalid: That data isn't in a valid format.
errors.onlyOwner: Only the owner can change workspace settings.
errors.timeZoneInvalid: Invalid time zone — use an IANA name such as Asia/Taipei.
errors.kindSwitch: An existing to-do can't become an event, or the other way round — add a new one instead.
errors.amountDecimals: Amounts can have at most two decimal places.
errors.taxRateRange: The tax rate must be between 0 and 100%.
errors.settledDateRequired: Received or paid entries need the date settled.
errors.settledDateFuture: The date settled can't be later than today.
errors.balanceBeforeDeposit: The balance can't be due before the deposit.
errors.incomeExists: This project already has payment requests — edit those so nothing is counted twice.
errors.splitInvalid: Set a positive quote and a deposit between 0 and 100%.
errors.splitPartsPositive: Both deposit and balance must be greater than zero.
errors.counterpartyRequired: Enter a partner, or pick one from the list.
errors.languageRequired: Choose the language the reply is written in.
errors.projectNotSigned: Only signed projects can take new linked to-dos, events, and payments. Move the project to Signed first.
errors.projectArchived: This project is archived. Restore it before linking new items.
errors.quoteNotSet: Set the project's quote before splitting it.
errors.travelTimeRequired: Travel and stays need a time.
errors.wallTimeInvalid: That local time doesn't exist or happens twice (a daylight-saving change). Enter it in UTC instead.
errors.endIncomplete: Enter the arrival / check-out date, time, and time zone together — or leave all three blank.
errors.endBeforeStart: Arrival / check-out must be after departure / check-in (time zones included).
errors.pasteTooLong: That's too long to analyze — paste at most {max} characters.
errors.messageNotFound: Message not found, or it has already been handled.
errors.uploadInvalid: Send up to {files} screenshots, photos (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC), or PDFs.
errors.uploadTooLarge: That's too large — up to {files} files and {megabytes} MB in total.
errors.uploadMissing: An upload didn't finish. Please try again.
errors.aiDailyLimit: Today's AI analyses for this account are used up. It resets within 24 hours.

partners.intro: Built from signed projects and their payments. The on-time rate counts received payments — it isn't a credit score for the company.
partners.summary: {projects, plural, one {# project} other {# projects}} · {overdue} overdue
partners.empty: Add partners in Artists & partners and link them to projects to see their history here.
partners.counts: {paid} received payments have full dates; {late} arrived late. {unknown} without a due date aren't in the on-time rate.
partners.fewSamples: Fewer than 3 payments so far — look at the individual payments for now.
partners.methodBody: Projects count signed ones, archived included, and leave out negotiations. Voided entries and costs don't count. A deposit and a balance count as two payments; average days late looks only at payments received late. A payment not yet due isn't late.

musician.0: Arena dreams, one song at a time. Make something you love today. Your to-dos are right here.
musician.1: That demo can take another draft. A melody you love is worth the extra time.
musician.2: Whatever the crowd size, today's show deserves your sound. Make it yours.
musician.3: Headphones on, world turned down. Leave a little room for your own music today.
musician.4: Record that idea before it slips away. A great song can start with a voice note.
musician.5: Give that tricky section another listen today. The next chord might be the one.

manager.0: You're keeping a lot of people on track. Save a slot in the schedule for your own lunch, too.
manager.1: One email, one next step. You don't have to hold the whole day in your head.
manager.2: The work you do backstage gives someone room to shine out front. That matters.
manager.3: A confirmed date or a settled detail counts as progress. Give yourself credit for it.
manager.4: Let's get the day in order. When there's a break, take it—and have some water.
manager.5: Good partnerships need someone connecting the dots. One clear next step at a time.

video.0: Make room for a shot you love today. Not every frame has to start with a brief.
video.1: Stuck on an edit? Step away for a bit. Fresh eyes can find the cut.
video.2: Get the first cut out, then shape it. Today doesn't have to be the final export.
video.3: Some frames are worth waiting for. The light, rhythm, and details you notice become part of the work.
video.4: Charge the batteries, feed the crew—and yourself. You're part of the kit that needs looking after.
video.5: Pick one unfinished idea from that drive. You only need to move it a little further today.

influencer.0: Make something you'd want to watch today. Your life is bigger than the analytics tab.
influencer.1: Not every post has to go viral. Helping someone find something they love counts, too.
influencer.2: No ideas yet? Go live a little. Sometimes the next post finds you along the way.
influencer.3: Take your time choosing partnerships. The right fit leaves room for your own voice.
influencer.4: Share it your way. Your particular angle is part of what people come for.
influencer.5: Filmed, edited, posted—that's real work. Take a break before checking the numbers again.

model.0: Bring yourself to the frame today. You don't have to look like someone else to belong in it.
model.1: One casting isn't the whole story. Look after yourself; there will be other rooms to walk into.
model.2: Find your own pace today. That moment when you feel at ease can come through on camera.
model.3: Early call time? Have something to eat before you go. You deserve a comfortable start.
model.4: Every shoot is a chance to learn something about yourself. Try an expression that feels new to you.
model.5: When you wrap, let your shoulders drop. Showing up in front of the camera takes work.

other.0: Start with one thing that matters to you. A little progress still counts.
other.1: Your pace doesn't have to match anyone else's. Take your own next step today.
other.2: Some ideas need time to grow. Leave a little space for the one that isn't quite ready yet.
other.3: If the list feels long, choose one thing that matters most. Then take it from there.
other.4: There's a life outside the work, too. Save a little time for it today.
other.5: You don't have to feel certain to begin. A small experiment is a good start.
